heading: Prohibition of lump-sum payments
lead: In providing relocation assistance in connection with any program administered by the Department of Housing and Urban Development, the Secretary may not make lump-sum payments to any displaced residential tenant, except where necessary to cover—

tree.text: a downpayment on the purchase of a replacement residence, including a condominium unit or membership in a cooperative housing association; or
any incidental expenses related to paragraph (1) or (2).
